scenes.description: Dense high-rise, mixed residential, industrial, transport networks.
Sprawling tech corridor, urban lakes, mixed tree canopy and dense built-up.
Coastal megacity, linear high-density infrastructure, creek interface.
Granitic plateau topography, planned urban zones, rocky outcrops.
Intensive irrigated cereal parcels, regular rectilinear farm borders, canals.
Rainfed black soil agriculture, undulating terrain, seasonal crop patterns.
Alluvial deltaic paddy agro-ecosystem, high soil moisture, irrigation networks.
Deep Southern deltaic rice cultivation, canal distribution, distinct agro-climate.
Dense tropical wet evergreen rainforest, steep terrain, high canopy density.
Tropical moist deciduous Sal forest mixed with open grassland clearings.
Semi-evergreen riparian forest, tall alluvial grassland, river corridor.
Brackish coastal lagoon, barrier sand spit, wetland vegetation and mudflats.
Dense tidal mangrove swamp, dynamic intertidal channels, saline mudflats.
Tropical estuarine backwaters, reclaimed polders, narrow canals and barriers.

compressed_deflate_geotiff_or_npz.status: Analytical estimate based on empirical DEFLATE compression

storage_budget.critical_distinction_statement: The 201.6 MB figure is an ANALYTICAL ESTIMATE based on lossless DEFLATE compression applied to 16-bit surface reflectance. If stored uncompressed, the 42 ROIs would require 346.5 MB (UInt16) or 672.0 MB (Float32). To strictly respect the 250 MB ceiling, all downloaded ROI files must be saved with DEFLATE/LZW compression (GeoTIFF) or compressed NPZ.
